# Skapra Zombie

> Skapra Zombie is a ska punk band from Zürich, Switzerland.

- Website: https://skaprazombie.ch
- Genre: ska punk
- Songs: the band writes its own songs; Love and Petty Crimes contains its first published songs
- Founded: 2024
- Line-up: six members
- Location: Zürich, Switzerland
- Music: https://skaprazombie.bandcamp.com (album: Love and Petty Crimes, https://skaprazombie.bandcamp.com/album/love-and-petty-crimes)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/skaprazombie/
- Contact and booking: skaprazombie@gmail.com
- Events played: concerts and ska nights, festivals, support slots, themed nights (e.g. Halloween) and private parties such as weddings and birthdays

## Pages

- [Home](https://skaprazombie.ch): music, upcoming and past gigs, band photo and contact.
- [About](https://skaprazombie.ch/about): band description, founding year and band photo.
- [Booking](https://skaprazombie.ch/booking): which events the band plays and how to book it.
